Band 4 (30–39 km/h) is not a 'reasonable cause' under RD-4: F12 records no traffic incident near the optimal route, and RD-4(b) lets a band 1–2 reading only corroborate an incident, with a single band reading never excusing a segment — a 30–39 km/h expressway does not justify a 1.73 km / 947 m detour (F3).
